description: This file defines a PHP class LeaveCommentSearchFilterParams used as a data transfer object (DTO) to specify search filter parameters for leave comments, extending from a base date-range filter class.

classes.name: LeaveCommentSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering leave comments based on leave ID and date range, with sorting capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter object and sets the default sort field to 'leaveComment.createdAt'.

methods.name: getLeaveId
methods.description: Returns the leave ID filter, which can be null.

methods.name: setLeaveId
methods.description: Sets the leave ID filter parameter.
